title: SMIC now ~3 years behind TSMC, teardown analysis shows
summary: Tokyo-based TechanaLye disassembled Huawei’s Pura 70 Pro and found the SMIC-built Kirin 9010 (118.4 mm²) matching the performance of TSMC’s 5nm Kirin 9000 (107.8 mm²) — a three-year gap.

title: TSMC tech found inside Huawei AI chips via Sophgo
summary: TechInsights reverse-engineering reports established the link between TSMC circuitry and Huawei’s Ascend AI chips, triggering order cancellations and a US regulator report.

title: China adds TechInsights to its Unreliable Entity List
summary: Beijing barred the Canadian teardown firm from doing business with Chinese entities after its reports exposed TSMC, Samsung and SK hynix silicon inside Huawei’s most advanced chips.

title: Huawei Mate 60 Pro teardown reveals SMIC 7nm Kirin 9000S
summary: TechInsights’ teardown showed Huawei and SMIC built a 7-nanometer processor for the Mate 60 Pro — the breakthrough that proved China’s advanced-chip progress under sanctions.
